# Prompt Pattern: AI Review Automation

Use this skill to review automation implementation.

## Template
Review automation scope: <feature/pr/files>
Input files: <paths>
Traceability refs: <requirements/test-cases optional>
Evidence: <logs/flaky notes optional>

## Example
Review automation scope: PR-278 checkout tests
Input files: tests/regression/checkout.spec.ts
Traceability refs: TC-US-003-Checkout.md
Evidence: flaky-run-report.md
